blocks.zh: 前言、誌謝、第一章導論與第二章概念及法規哲學
blocks.en: Preface, Acknowledgements, Chapter 1 Introduction and Chapter 2 Concepts and Regulatory Philosophy

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Risk-MaPP 的核心使命：在「共用廠房」中管理交叉污染風險，平衡病患安全與員工安全
blocks.en: Understand the core mission of Risk-MaPP: managing cross-contamination risk in shared facilities while balancing patient safety and employee safety

blocks.zh: 掌握本指引第二版修訂的五大驅動因素，尤其是 EU GMP Chapter 3/5 更新與 EMA HBEL 指引
blocks.en: Grasp the five drivers behind the second edition of this guide, especially the updates to EU GMP Chapters 3/5 and the EMA HBEL guideline

blocks.zh: 區分 HBEL（Health-Based Exposure Limit） 與 OEL（Occupational Exposure Limit） 的根本差異及應用場景
blocks.en: Distinguish the fundamental differences and use cases of HBEL (Health-Based Exposure Limit) and OEL (Occupational Exposure Limit)

blocks.zh: 了解主要法規驅動力：EMA HBEL Guideline（2014）、EU GMP Annex 15（2015）、21 CFR 211.42(c)
blocks.en: Know the main regulatory drivers: EMA HBEL Guideline (2014), EU GMP Annex 15 (2015), 21 CFR 211.42(c)

blocks.zh: 認識高危害藥物的分類邏輯：細胞毒性藥物、荷爾蒙、致敏劑（Beta-Lactam）
blocks.en: Understand the classification logic for high-hazard drugs: cytotoxics, hormones, sensitizers (beta-lactams)

blocks.zh: 掌握風險管理生命週期八步驟：識別 → 分析 → 評估 → 控制 → 降低 → 接受 → 審查 → 溝通
blocks.en: Master the eight steps of the risk management lifecycle: Identification → Analysis → Evaluation → Control → Reduction → Acceptance → Review → Communication

blocks.zh: 理解 GMP 視角（病患保護）與工業衛生視角（工人保護）的差異與平衡策略
blocks.en: Understand the difference between the GMP perspective (patient protection) and the industrial hygiene perspective (worker protection), and strategies for balancing them

blocks.zh: Preface（前言）
blocks.en: Preface

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 的存在理由
blocks.en: Why Risk-MaPP Exists

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP = Risk-Based Manufacture of Pharmaceutical Products。這本指引解決一個真實的產業痛點：
blocks.en: Risk-MaPP = Risk-Based Manufacture of Pharmaceutical Products. This guide addresses a real pain point in the industry:

blocks.zh: 藥廠為節省成本，同一設施生產多種藥品（共用廠房）
blocks.en: To save costs, manufacturers make multiple products in the same facility (shared facilities)

blocks.zh: 2015 年 EU GMP 更新要求必須做風險評估，但沒有告訴業者「怎麼做」
blocks.en: The 2015 EU GMP update requires a risk assessment but does not tell companies how to do it

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 就是填補這個空白的實務指南
blocks.en: Risk-MaPP is the practical guide that fills this gap

blocks.zh: 核心問題只有一個：「在共用廠房製造藥品時，交叉污染的風險是否可接受？」
blocks.en: There is only one core question: "When manufacturing medicinal products in a shared facility, is the risk of cross-contamination acceptable?"

blocks.zh: 比喻：共用廚房的食物過敏風險
blocks.en: Analogy: Food Allergy Risk in a Shared Kitchen

blocks.zh: 想像一家餐廳同一個廚房既做花生菜餚也做無過敏原餐點。如何確保花生不污染其他食物？你需要：評估花生的危害程度 → 分析污染途徑 → 設定清潔標準 → 確認殘留量低於安全閾值。
blocks.en: Imagine a restaurant whose kitchen prepares both peanut dishes and allergen-free meals. How do you make sure the peanuts do not contaminate the other food? You need to: assess how hazardous peanuts are → analyze the contamination pathways → set cleaning standards → confirm that residues are below the safe threshold.

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 做的就是把這個邏輯系統化、科學化、文件化，適用於製藥的多產品生產。
blocks.en: Risk-MaPP systematizes this logic, makes it scientific and documents it, for multi-product pharmaceutical manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 第二版 vs 第一版：主要變化
blocks.en: Second Edition vs. First Edition: Key Changes

blocks.zh: 納入 EU GMP Chapter 3 & 5 新要求（2015 年生效）
blocks.en: Incorporates the new requirements of EU GMP Chapters 3 & 5 (effective 2015)

blocks.zh: 整合 EMA HBEL Guideline（2014 年 11 月發布）
blocks.en: Integrates the EMA HBEL Guideline (published November 2014)

blocks.zh: 新增清潔、HVAC 章節內容與更新範例
blocks.en: Adds content on cleaning and HVAC, with updated examples

blocks.zh: FDA 與 EMA 均參與審閱，確保不牴觸新法規
blocks.en: Both FDA and EMA took part in the review, to ensure the guide does not conflict with the new regulations

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務思考
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Considerations

blocks.zh: 作為無菌充填的 CDMO，你的廠房同時生產多個客戶的產品——這正是 Risk-MaPP 最直接的應用場景。當客戶稽核問：「你如何確保我的產品不被其他產品污染？」Risk-MaPP 提供了完整的回答框架。
blocks.en: As a sterile fill-finish CDMO, your facility makes products for several clients at the same time, which is exactly the most direct application of Risk-MaPP. When a client auditor asks, "How do you make sure my product is not contaminated by other products?", Risk-MaPP gives you a complete framework for the answer.

blocks.zh: Acknowledgements（誌謝）
blocks.en: Acknowledgements

blocks.zh: 作者組成的意義：跨學科整合
blocks.en: What the Authorship Means: Cross-Disciplinary Integration

blocks.zh: 這份指引的作者陣容非常特殊——不是單一領域的專家，而是刻意整合了：
blocks.en: The author team of this guide is unusual: rather than experts from a single field, it deliberately brings together:

blocks.zh: 毒理學家（Naumann PhD, DABT）——設定科學安全限值
blocks.en: Toxicologists (Naumann PhD, DABT): set the scientifically based safety limits

blocks.zh: 工業衛生師（Abromovitz CIH, Burgess）——員工暴露管理
blocks.en: Industrial hygienists (Abromovitz CIH, Burgess): manage employee exposure

blocks.zh: 製程工程師（Marshall CEng）——設施設計與清潔
blocks.en: Process engineers (Marshall CEng): facility design and cleaning

blocks.zh: 品質保證（Holmes, Hamilton）——GMP 法規符合
blocks.en: Quality assurance (Holmes, Hamilton): GMP compliance

blocks.zh: 法規機構（FDA, EMA, SwissMedic）——確保法規一致性
blocks.en: Regulators (FDA, EMA, SwissMedic): ensure regulatory consistency

blocks.zh: 這個多元組合正是 Risk-MaPP 最大的特色：它不是「純 GMP 視角」，也不是「純工業衛生視角」，而是兩者的平衡。
blocks.en: This diverse mix is the greatest strength of Risk-MaPP: it is neither a "pure GMP perspective" nor a "pure industrial hygiene perspective", but a balance of the two.

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築法規的多方共筆
blocks.en: Analogy: Building Codes Written by Many Hands

blocks.zh: 這就像制定建築安全規範，需要結構工程師（安全）、消防工程師（逃生）、建築師（設計）、衛生局（衛生）以及建管單位（法規）共同參與——缺少任何一方，規範都會有盲點。
blocks.en: It is like drafting a building safety code, which needs structural engineers (safety), fire engineers (escape), architects (design), the health department (hygiene) and the building authority (regulation) all at the table; if any one is missing, the code has blind spots.

blocks.zh: EMA 深度參與的重要性
blocks.en: Why EMA's Deep Involvement Matters

blocks.zh: 第二版特別強調 EMA HBEL 實施團隊的參與。這意味著 Risk-MaPP 第二版的核心框架——以 HBEL 作為決策基礎——已取得 EMA 的隱性認可。在 EU GMP 稽核中，引用本指引的方法論具有較強的說服力。
blocks.en: The second edition specifically stresses the participation of the EMA HBEL implementation team. This means the core framework of the second edition of Risk-MaPP, with HBEL as the basis for decisions, has received EMA's tacit endorsement. In an EU GMP inspection, citing the methodology of this guide is more persuasive.

blocks.zh: Chapter 1: Introduction（第一章：導論）
blocks.en: Chapter 1: Introduction

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 的雙重目標
blocks.en: The Dual Objectives of Risk-MaPP

blocks.zh: 開篇一句話點出了 Risk-MaPP 的本質：它同時服務兩個對象——
blocks.en: The opening sentence captures the essence of Risk-MaPP: it serves two parties at the same time:

blocks.zh: 病患安全：確保產品不因交叉污染而影響療效或安全性（GMP 視角）
blocks.en: Patient safety: ensure that the product's efficacy or safety is not affected by cross-contamination (GMP perspective)

blocks.zh: 員工安全：確保操作人員不因接觸高活性藥物而受害（工業衛生視角）
blocks.en: Employee safety: ensure that operators are not harmed by exposure to highly active drugs (industrial hygiene perspective)

blocks.zh: 這兩個目標有時會有張力，Risk-MaPP 的價值在於提供一個系統化的方法來同時滿足兩者。
blocks.en: These two objectives sometimes pull against each other; the value of Risk-MaPP lies in providing a systematic method to satisfy both at once.

blocks.zh: 1.1 Scope of this Guide（指引範圍）
blocks.en: 1.1 Scope of this Guide

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：比你想的更廣
blocks.en: Scope of Application: Broader Than You Think

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 的適用對象涵蓋：
blocks.en: Risk-MaPP applies to:

blocks.zh: 大分子量 API（生物製劑）與小分子量 API（化學合成藥）
blocks.en: Large-molecule APIs (biologics) and small-molecule APIs (chemically synthesized drugs)

blocks.zh: 臨床前、臨床試驗材料與上市商業化產品
blocks.en: Preclinical and clinical trial materials, as well as marketed commercial products

blocks.zh: 所有劑型（注射劑、口服固體、外用等）
blocks.en: All dosage forms (injectables, oral solids, topicals, etc.)

blocks.zh: 任何設施規模，從小型研發設施到大型商業生產廠
blocks.en: Facilities of any size, from small R&D facilities to large commercial manufacturing plants

blocks.zh: 關鍵前提：這不是給初學者的手冊——第 2 點明確要求 SME 參與。
blocks.en: Key prerequisite: this is not a handbook for beginners; point 2 explicitly requires the involvement of SMEs.

blocks.zh: 「Controls」的四個層次
blocks.en: The Four Levels of "Controls"

blocks.zh: 注意本指引對「controls（管制措施）」的廣義定義——這是一個從最輕到最重的連續體：
blocks.en: Note the broad definition of "controls" in this guide: it is a continuum from lightest to heaviest:

blocks.zh: 程序性管制（最輕）：SOP、工作指引、訓練
blocks.en: Procedural controls (lightest): SOPs, work instructions, training

blocks.zh: 操作管制：排程隔離、campaign 生產
blocks.en: Operational controls: scheduling segregation, campaign manufacturing

blocks.zh: 工程管制：設備設計、HVAC、密閉系統
blocks.en: Engineering controls: equipment design, HVAC, closed systems

blocks.zh: 完全專用/隔離（最重）：獨立廠房、專用設備
blocks.en: Full dedication/segregation (heaviest): separate facilities, dedicated equipment

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 的核心貢獻：讓企業能夠根據風險高低選擇適當層次，而非一律採用最嚴格措施。
blocks.en: The core contribution of Risk-MaPP: it lets companies choose the appropriate level according to the level of risk, rather than always applying the strictest measures.

blocks.zh: 比喻：駕駛安全等級
blocks.en: Analogy: Levels of Driving Safety

blocks.zh: 一個危險化學品運輸公司的風險管理：低風險貨物（程序控制：注意路標）→ 中風險（操作控制：特定時段行駛）→ 高風險（工程控制：密閉罐車）→ 極高風險（完全隔離：專用道路）。Risk-MaPP 就是幫你決定每種藥品應該用哪個等級的「運輸方式」。
blocks.en: Consider risk management at a hazardous-chemicals transport company: low-risk cargo (procedural control: watch the road signs) → medium risk (operational control: drive only at specified times) → high risk (engineering control: sealed tanker) → very high risk (full segregation: dedicated road). Risk-MaPP helps you decide which level of "transport method" each drug product should use.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填 CDMO 的實踐問題
blocks.en: A Practical Problem for a Sterile Fill-Finish CDMO

blocks.zh: 你的廠房同時承接一般抗生素、荷爾蒙藥物、和普通小分子藥品的充填作業。問：
blocks.en: Your facility fills general antibiotics, hormonal drugs and ordinary small-molecule drugs at the same time. Questions:

blocks.zh: 這三類產品應分別採用哪個層次的 controls？
blocks.en: Which level of controls should each of these three product types use?

blocks.zh: 若客戶要求引入一個新的細胞毒性藥物，觸發哪些評估步驟？
blocks.en: If a client asks to introduce a new cytotoxic drug, which assessment steps are triggered?

blocks.zh: SME 組成應包含哪些專業背景的人？
blocks.en: What professional backgrounds should the SME team include?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Background（背景）
blocks.en: 1.2 Background

blocks.zh: 「零風險」的科學破除
blocks.en: Debunking "Zero Risk" Scientifically

blocks.zh: 這段背景提出了 Risk-MaPP 最重要的哲學前提：零風險是科學上無法實現的目標。ICH Q9、FDA、EMA 三大機構均一致認同這個立場。
blocks.en: This section of the background sets out the most important philosophical premise of Risk-MaPP: zero risk is scientifically unattainable. ICH Q9, FDA and EMA all agree on this position.

blocks.zh: 這個前提有實際意義：它允許藥廠用「風險可接受」而非「風險為零」作為決策標準。如果你的稽核員堅持要求「零殘留」，這個概念就是你的科學依據。
blocks.en: This premise has practical consequences: it allows manufacturers to use "acceptable risk" rather than "zero risk" as the decision criterion. If your auditor insists on "zero residue", this concept is your scientific basis.

blocks.zh: 高危害藥物的歷史分類
blocks.en: The Historical Classification of High-Hazard Drugs

blocks.zh: 這段列出了傳統上需要專用設施的化合物類型，理解這個分類的歷史背景很重要：
blocks.en: This section lists the types of compounds that have traditionally required dedicated facilities; it is important to understand the historical background of this classification:

blocks.zh: 細胞毒性/遺傳毒性藥物：癌症化療藥，低劑量即有效/有毒
blocks.en: Cytotoxic/genotoxic drugs: cancer chemotherapy agents, effective/toxic at low doses

blocks.zh: 荷爾蒙（尤其是性荷爾蒙）：微量即可影響體內平衡
blocks.en: Hormones (especially sex hormones): trace amounts can affect homeostasis

blocks.zh: Beta-Lactam 抗生素：特殊案例——問題不在毒性，而在致敏性（不可用 HBEL 計算，必須專用廠房）
blocks.en: Beta-lactam antibiotics: a special case; the problem is not toxicity but sensitization (cannot be handled with an HBEL calculation; dedicated facilities are required)

blocks.zh: 獸藥：非人體用藥，交叉污染至人用藥風險獨特
blocks.en: Veterinary drugs: not intended for humans, so the risk of cross-contamination into human medicines is unique

blocks.zh: 注意：Risk-MaPP 的方法論不適用於高致敏性物質（如 Beta-Lactam），那類必須直接專用廠房。
blocks.en: Note: the Risk-MaPP methodology is not applicable to highly sensitizing substances (such as beta-lactams), which must go straight to dedicated facilities.

blocks.zh: 比喻：食品業的過敏原管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Allergen Management in the Food Industry

blocks.zh: 花生過敏者對花生的反應類似 Beta-Lactam 的致敏性——即使是極微量殘留也可能引發嚴重反應（過敏性休克）。這類物質不能用「可接受殘留量」來管理，只能徹底隔離。Risk-MaPP 的風險量化方法適用於「多少量會有多少毒性效果」可以計算的化合物，不適用於「任何量都可能觸發免疫過激反應」的致敏劑。
blocks.en: A person with a peanut allergy reacts to peanuts much as beta-lactam sensitization works: even a very small residue can trigger a severe reaction (anaphylaxis). Such substances cannot be managed with an "acceptable residue level"; they can only be fully segregated. The risk quantification method of Risk-MaPP applies to compounds for which "how much dose produces how much toxic effect" can be calculated, and not to sensitizers for which "any amount may trigger an exaggerated immune reaction".

blocks.zh: 1.3 Reasons for Revisions（修訂原因）
blocks.en: 1.3 Reasons for Revisions

blocks.zh: 五大修訂驅動力的時間軸
blocks.en: Timeline of the Five Revision Drivers

blocks.zh: 第一版（2010 年）→ 第二版（2017 年），7 年間的法規環境劇變：
blocks.en: From the first edition (2010) to the second edition (2017), the regulatory environment changed dramatically over seven years:

blocks.zh: 2014 年 8 月：EU GMP Chapter 3 & 5 更新，正式要求毒理學評估
blocks.en: August 2014: EU GMP Chapters 3 & 5 updated, formally requiring a toxicological assessment

blocks.zh: 2014 年 11 月：EMA HBEL Guideline 發布，定義 PDE = ADE
blocks.en: November 2014: EMA HBEL Guideline published, defining PDE = ADE

blocks.zh: 2014 年：ICH M7 發布，設定基因毒性雜質的 TTC 概念
blocks.en: 2014: ICH M7 published, setting the TTC concept for genotoxic impurities

blocks.zh: 2015 年：EU GMP Annex 15 更新，清潔驗證限值需基於毒理學評估
blocks.en: 2015: EU GMP Annex 15 updated; cleaning validation limits must be based on a toxicological assessment

blocks.zh: 2011 年起：FDA Process Validation Guideline 推動生命週期方法
blocks.en: From 2011: FDA Process Validation Guidance promotes a lifecycle approach

blocks.zh: 關鍵等號：PDE = ADE
blocks.en: The Key Equation: PDE = ADE

blocks.zh: 這個等式非常重要：
blocks.en: This equation is very important:

blocks.zh: PDE（Permitted Daily Exposure）= EMA 用語，源自 ICH Q3C 殘留溶劑概念
blocks.en: PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure) = EMA term, derived from the ICH Q3C residual solvent concept

blocks.zh: ADE（Acceptable Daily Exposure）= ISPE/Risk-MaPP 用語，業界工業衛生傳統
blocks.en: ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure) = ISPE/Risk-MaPP term, from the industrial hygiene tradition

blocks.zh: 兩者計算方法本質上相同——都基於毒理學數據，考慮 NOAEL、不確定因子、體重調整、給藥途徑等。EMA 在 2014 年指引中正式聲明兩者「本質上同義」，統一了業界術語。
blocks.en: The two are calculated in essentially the same way: both are based on toxicological data and take into account the NOAEL, uncertainty factors, body weight adjustment, route of administration and so on. In its 2014 guideline, EMA formally stated that the two are "essentially synonymous", unifying industry terminology.

blocks.zh: 實務提示：在文件中，使用 PDE/ADE 都可以被接受，但最好保持一致，並說明與另一術語的關係。
blocks.en: Practical tip: in documents, using either PDE or ADE is acceptable, but it is best to be consistent and to explain the relationship to the other term.

blocks.zh: 生命週期驗證方法的重要轉變
blocks.en: An Important Shift to the Lifecycle Approach to Validation

blocks.zh: 第 4 點的清潔驗證生命週期概念影響深遠：
blocks.en: The cleaning validation lifecycle concept in point 4 has far-reaching impact:

blocks.zh: 舊觀念：清潔驗證 = 三批次測試，通過後完成
blocks.en: Old view: cleaning validation = three-batch testing, done once it passes

blocks.zh:
新觀念：清潔驗證 = 持續的過程控制，需要：
設計階段（了解殘留行為）→ 確認階段（驗證清潔有效性）→ 持續驗證（監控日常清潔效果）
blocks.en:
New view: cleaning validation = ongoing process control, which requires:
design stage (understand residue behavior) → qualification stage (verify cleaning effectiveness) → continued verification (monitor routine cleaning performance)

blocks.zh: 這個概念與 Risk-MaPP 高度契合：風險管理不是一次性評估，而是持續的生命週期活動。
blocks.en: This concept fits Risk-MaPP closely: risk management is not a one-time assessment but a continuous lifecycle activity.

blocks.en: 1.4 Structure of this Guide

blocks.en: Risk Management Lifecycle: The Structure of the Guide

blocks.en: The chapter structure of the whole of Risk-MaPP is the concrete implementation of the ICH Q9 risk management process:

blocks.zh: 「整體閱讀」的警告
blocks.en: The Warning to Read the Guide as a Whole

blocks.zh: 指引特別強調必須「整體」理解，不能斷章取義。實務中常見的錯誤：
blocks.en: The guide specifically stresses that it must be understood as a whole and not quoted out of context. Common mistakes in practice:

blocks.zh: 只看第 5 章（HBEL 設定）而跳過第 6 章（暴露分析），導致限值設錯
blocks.en: Reading only Chapter 5 (HBEL setting) and skipping Chapter 6 (exposure analysis), resulting in wrongly set limits

blocks.zh: 只看第 9 章（風險降低措施）而不執行第 5-7 章，無法證明措施是否充分
blocks.en: Reading only Chapter 9 (risk reduction measures) without carrying out Chapters 5-7, so there is no way to demonstrate that the measures are adequate

blocks.zh: 只引用 ADE 數值而不理解其假設條件，被稽核員質疑
blocks.en: Quoting only the ADE value without understanding its underlying assumptions, and being challenged by the auditor

blocks.zh: 比喻：食譜書的閱讀方式
blocks.en: Analogy: How to Read a Recipe Book

blocks.zh: 就像食譜書——你不能只看「加一茶匙鹽」這一步，而要了解整個烹飪流程。每個步驟都有前因後果。Risk-MaPP 的邏輯流程更是如此：前一章的輸出是下一章的輸入。
blocks.en: It is like a recipe book: you cannot look only at the step "add one teaspoon of salt"; you have to understand the whole cooking process. Every step has its causes and consequences. This applies even more to the logical flow of Risk-MaPP: the output of one chapter is the input of the next.

blocks.zh: Chapter 2: Concepts and Regulatory Philosophy（第二章：概念與法規哲學）
blocks.en: Chapter 2: Concepts and Regulatory Philosophy

blocks.zh: 全球法規現況：進行中的轉型
blocks.en: The Global Regulatory Picture: A Transition in Progress

blocks.zh: 截至 2017 年（第二版出版時），全球法規呈現「先進 vs. 保守」的分化：
blocks.en: As of 2017 (when the second edition was published), global regulations were split between "progressive" and "conservative":

blocks.zh: 積極接受風險方法：FDA、EMA、SwissMedic
blocks.en: Actively accept the risk-based approach: FDA, EMA, SwissMedic

blocks.zh: 允許有條件共用生產：WHO、MHLW（日本）
blocks.en: Allow conditional shared manufacturing: WHO, MHLW (Japan)

blocks.zh: 仍堅持嚴格隔離：部分亞洲與新興市場法規機構
blocks.en: Still insist on strict segregation: some regulators in Asia and emerging markets

blocks.zh: FDA 和 EMA 明確要求「文件化風險評估」——這不是選項，是義務。
blocks.en: FDA and EMA explicitly require a "documented risk assessment"; this is not optional but an obligation.

blocks.zh: 2.1 EudraLex – EU GMP Updates（歐盟 GMP 更新）
blocks.en: 2.1 EudraLex – EU GMP Updates

blocks.zh: 必須專用廠房的三種情況
blocks.en: The Three Situations That Require Dedicated Facilities

blocks.zh: EU GMP 3.6 列出的三個觸發點非常清晰，也是稽核員的檢查清單：
blocks.en: The three triggers listed in EU GMP 3.6 are very clear and are also the auditor's checklist:

blocks.zh: 技術/操作措施不足：即使使用所有工程控制手段，風險仍無法充分控制
blocks.en: Technical/operational measures are insufficient: even with all engineering controls, the risk still cannot be adequately controlled

blocks.zh: 毒理學數據不支持：最典型的就是 Beta-Lactam 的致敏性——科學無法設定「安全殘留量」
blocks.en: Toxicological data do not support it: the classic example is the sensitization of beta-lactams, where science cannot set a "safe residue level"

blocks.zh: 無法驗證的分析方法：如果連殘留量都無法被可靠地偵測，就無法確認清潔有效性
blocks.en: Analytical methods cannot be validated: if residues cannot even be reliably detected, the effectiveness of cleaning cannot be confirmed

blocks.zh: 注意：這三點是「必須」（required）專用，不是「建議」。
blocks.en: Note: these three points are "required" dedication, not "recommended".

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Section 5.20 的稽核意涵
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Audit Implications of Section 5.20

blocks.zh: Section 5.20 是 EU GMP 查廠時最常被引用的條文。稽核員會問：
blocks.en: Section 5.20 is the clause most often cited in EU GMP inspections. Auditors will ask:

blocks.zh: 你的 QRM 流程是否包含毒效學評估？（ADE/PDE 報告在哪？）
blocks.en: Does your QRM process include a toxicological assessment? (Where is the ADE/PDE report?)

blocks.zh: 設施/設備設計、人員/物料流向是否在風險評估中被考慮？
blocks.en: Are facility/equipment design and the flow of personnel/materials considered in the risk assessment?

blocks.zh: 你的分析方法是否足夠靈敏到偵測到相關殘留限值？
blocks.en: Is your analytical method sensitive enough to detect the relevant residue limits?

blocks.zh: 是否有定期審查機制確保管制措施持續有效？
blocks.en: Is there a periodic review mechanism to ensure the controls remain effective?

blocks.zh: EU GMP Chapter 3 & 5 的革命性改變
blocks.en: The Revolutionary Change in EU GMP Chapters 3 & 5

blocks.zh: 2014 年 8 月的 EU GMP 更新是 Risk-MaPP 第二版的最主要驅動力。改變前後的對比：
blocks.en: The August 2014 EU GMP update was the main driver of the second edition of Risk-MaPP. A comparison of before and after the change:

blocks.zh: 2.2 EMA HBEL Guideline（EMA 健康暴露限值指引）
blocks.en: 2.2 EMA HBEL Guideline

blocks.zh: PDE 的概念起源與擴展
blocks.en: Origin and Extension of the PDE Concept

blocks.zh: PDE 概念的發展歷程：
blocks.en: How the PDE concept developed:

blocks.zh: ICH Q3C（1997）：PDE 首次用於藥品中殘留溶劑的安全限值
blocks.en: ICH Q3C (1997): PDE first used for safety limits of residual solvents in drug products

blocks.zh: ICH Q3D（2014）：擴展 PDE 概念至元素雜質
blocks.en: ICH Q3D (2014): extended the PDE concept to elemental impurities

blocks.zh: EMA HBEL（2014）：進一步擴展至藥品活性成分在共用設施中的交叉污染控制
blocks.en: EMA HBEL (2014): further extended to the control of cross-contamination by active pharmaceutical ingredients in shared facilities

blocks.zh: PDE 定義的關鍵詞：「一生每天暴露於此劑量或以下，不可能引起不良效應」。注意「終生」（lifetime）和「任何途徑」（any route）兩個重要假設。
blocks.en: Key wording of the PDE definition: "a dose unlikely to cause an adverse effect if an individual is exposed at or below this dose every day for a lifetime". Note the two important assumptions: "lifetime" and "any route".

blocks.zh: PDE/ADE 計算框架（概覽）
blocks.en: PDE/ADE Calculation Framework (Overview)

blocks.zh: PDE = NOAEL × 體重調整係數 / (F1 × F2 × F3 × F4 × F5)
blocks.en: PDE = NOAEL × weight adjustment factor / (F1 × F2 × F3 × F4 × F5)

blocks.zh: NOAEL：無觀察到不良效應劑量（來自毒理學研究）
blocks.en: NOAEL: No Observed Adverse Effect Level (from toxicology studies)

blocks.zh: F1：種間差異（動物→人，通常 ×5 或 ×12）
blocks.en: F1: interspecies differences (animal → human, typically ×5 or ×12)

blocks.zh: F2：個體間差異（一般 ×10）
blocks.en: F2: interindividual differences (generally ×10)

blocks.zh: F3：研究期限（短期 vs. 長期研究）
blocks.en: F3: study duration (short-term vs. long-term studies)

blocks.zh: F4：嚴重/不可逆毒性調整
blocks.en: F4: adjustment for severe/irreversible toxicity

blocks.zh: F5：其他不確定性
blocks.en: F5: other uncertainties

blocks.zh: 計算 PDE 需要具備毒理學專業背景的 SME。不建議非專業人員自行計算。
blocks.en: Calculating a PDE requires an SME with a toxicology background. It is not recommended that non-specialists calculate it themselves.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：API 製造 + 製劑生產
blocks.en: Scope: API Manufacturing + Drug Product Manufacturing

blocks.zh: EMA HBEL 指引明確涵蓋原料藥（API）製造廠和製劑廠（finished dosage）兩個層次。這意味著：
blocks.en: The EMA HBEL guideline explicitly covers two levels: active substance (API) manufacturing sites and finished dosage form sites. This means:

blocks.zh: API 供應商做多種 API 共用設備時，需要 HBEL
blocks.en: An API supplier that shares equipment among multiple APIs needs an HBEL

blocks.zh: 製劑廠做多產品充填時，同樣需要 HBEL
blocks.en: A drug product manufacturer filling multiple products likewise needs an HBEL

blocks.zh: CDMO 同時承接 API 合成和製劑業務，兩個場景都要評估
blocks.en: A CDMO that takes on both API synthesis and drug product work must assess both scenarios

blocks.zh: 2.3 EU GMP Annex 2 – Biological Medicinal Products（生物藥品製造）
blocks.en: 2.3 EU GMP Annex 2 – Biological Medicinal Products

blocks.zh: 生物藥品的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Special Challenges of Biological Products

blocks.zh: Annex 2 提醒為什麼生物製品更需要 QRM 思維：
blocks.en: Annex 2 is a reminder of why biological products need QRM thinking even more:

blocks.zh: 固有可變性：生物製程（細胞培養、發酵）天然就有批次間差異，副產物組成不固定
blocks.en: Inherent variability: biological processes (cell culture, fermentation) naturally show batch-to-batch variation, and the composition of by-products is not fixed

blocks.zh: 複雜性：蛋白質、多醣等大分子的特性遠比小分子複雜，難以用單一化學指標評估風險
blocks.en: Complexity: large molecules such as proteins and polysaccharides are far more complex than small molecules, and their risk is hard to assess with a single chemical indicator

blocks.zh: 交叉污染的特殊形式：生物藥的交叉污染可能包括宿主細胞蛋白、DNA、病毒等
blocks.en: Special forms of cross-contamination: cross-contamination of biologicals can include host cell proteins, DNA, viruses and so on

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 原則可以應用於生物製品，但 Annex 2 的引用是提醒：評估時需要考慮生物製品的獨特複雜性。
blocks.en: The Risk-MaPP principles can be applied to biological products, but the reference to Annex 2 is a reminder that the assessment must take their unique complexity into account.

blocks.zh: CDMO 無菌充填的實際含義
blocks.en: What This Means in Practice for a Sterile Fill-Finish CDMO

blocks.zh: 若你的 CDMO 同時承接生物製劑（如單株抗體）和小分子注射劑的充填，需要特別注意：
blocks.en: If your CDMO fills both biologics (such as monoclonal antibodies) and small-molecule injectables, pay particular attention to the following:

blocks.zh: 生物製劑的 ADE 計算需要不同的毒理學考量（效價、免疫原性等）
blocks.en: ADE calculation for biologics requires different toxicological considerations (potency, immunogenicity, etc.)

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證需考慮大分子蛋白質的清潔困難性
blocks.en: Cleaning validation must take into account how difficult large-molecule proteins are to clean

blocks.zh: 分析方法需能區分並偵測生物製劑特有的殘留物
blocks.en: Analytical methods must be able to distinguish and detect residues specific to biologics

blocks.zh: 2.4 EU GMP Annex 15 – Qualification and Validation（確效與驗證）
blocks.en: 2.4 EU GMP Annex 15 – Qualification and Validation

blocks.zh: PIC/S 跟進：台灣 GMP 的影響
blocks.en: PIC/S Follows: Impact on Taiwan GMP

blocks.zh: 特別注意：PIC/S Annex 15 同步採用了相同語言。台灣 PIC/S GMP 成員國，這意味著台灣 PIC/S 認證廠的清潔驗證計算方式，也應轉向基於毒理學評估的方法。
blocks.en: Note in particular: PIC/S Annex 15 adopted the same language. Taiwan is a PIC/S GMP member, so for PIC/S-certified sites in Taiwan the way cleaning validation limits are calculated should also move toward a toxicology-based approach.

blocks.zh: 如果你的廠房目前仍使用「10 ppm」或「1/1000 TDD」作為唯一清潔限值依據，可能需要更新至 ADE/PDE 基礎的計算。
blocks.en: If your facility still uses "10 ppm" or "1/1000 TDD" as the sole basis for cleaning limits, you may need to update to a calculation based on ADE/PDE.

blocks.zh: 比喻：食品最大殘留量（MRL）的科學化
blocks.en: Analogy: Making Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) in Food Scientific

blocks.zh: 就像食品農藥殘留標準從過去的「感覺合理」進化到現在的「基於每日可接受攝入量（ADI）科學計算」，藥品清潔驗證限值也完成了同樣的轉型——從經驗法則轉為科學依據。
blocks.en: Just as food pesticide residue standards evolved from "seems reasonable" to being "scientifically calculated from the Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI)", cleaning validation limits for drugs have made the same transition, from rules of thumb to a scientific basis.

blocks.zh: Annex 15 的清潔驗證革命
blocks.en: The Cleaning Validation Revolution in Annex 15

blocks.zh: 2015 年 Annex 15 更新前後的清潔驗證方式對比：
blocks.en: A comparison of cleaning validation approaches before and after the 2015 Annex 15 update:

blocks.zh: 2.5 US FDA 21 CFR 211.42（美國 FDA 法規要求）
blocks.en: 2.5 US FDA 21 CFR 211.42

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.42 的解讀重點
blocks.en: Key Points in Interpreting 21 CFR 211.42

blocks.zh: 這條法規的關鍵在於：「separate or defined areas or such other control systems」。
blocks.en: The key to this regulation is: "separate or defined areas or such other control systems".

blocks.zh: 「or such other control systems」是 Risk-MaPP 存在的法律空間——FDA 的條文本身已允許用「其他管制系統」替代「實體隔離」。Risk-MaPP 提供的就是這個「other control systems」的科學依據和文件架構。
blocks.en: "Or such other control systems" is the legal room in which Risk-MaPP exists: the FDA text itself already allows "other control systems" as an alternative to "physical segregation". What Risk-MaPP provides is the scientific basis and documentation structure for these "other control systems".

blocks.zh: 危害 × 暴露 = 風險：三角關係
blocks.en: Hazard × Exposure = Risk: The Triangle Relationship

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 的核心風險公式：
blocks.en: The core risk formula of Risk-MaPP:

blocks.zh: 危害（Hazard）：化合物的固有屬性，不能改變（ADE 是量化指標）
blocks.en: Hazard: an inherent property of the compound that cannot be changed (ADE is the quantitative indicator)

blocks.zh: 暴露（Exposure）：接觸危害的程度，可以透過管制措施降低
blocks.en: Exposure: the degree of contact with the hazard, which can be reduced through controls

blocks.zh: 風險（Risk）= 危害嚴重性 × 暴露發生機率
blocks.en: Risk = severity of the hazard × probability of exposure

blocks.zh: 結論：因為危害（化合物毒性）無法改變，降低風險的唯一手段是降低暴露。這就是所有管制措施的理論基礎。
blocks.en: Conclusion: because the hazard (the toxicity of the compound) cannot be changed, the only way to reduce risk is to reduce exposure. This is the theoretical basis of all controls.

blocks.zh: 「高危害藥物辨識」的概念轉變
blocks.en: A Shift in Thinking on "Identifying High-Hazard Drugs"

blocks.zh: 值得注意的思維轉變：第一版原本想提供「高危害藥物清單」，但最終改為提供「可接受風險評估框架」。
blocks.en: A notable shift in thinking: the first edition originally intended to provide a "list of high-hazard drugs" but ultimately provided an "acceptable risk assessment framework" instead.

blocks.zh: 原因：
blocks.en: Reasons:

blocks.zh: 「高危害」是相對概念，取決於管控能力
blocks.en: "High hazard" is a relative concept that depends on the ability to control it

blocks.zh: 貼標籤（cytotoxic、potent）容易引發情緒化決策
blocks.en: Labels (cytotoxic, potent) easily lead to emotional decisions

blocks.zh: 科學的做法是：設定 ADE → 評估暴露 → 計算風險 → 決定管控等級
blocks.en: The scientific approach is: set the ADE → assess exposure → calculate risk → decide the level of control

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證整合框架
blocks.en: Integrated Framework for Cleaning Validation

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 與清潔驗證的整合邏輯：
blocks.en: The integration logic between Risk-MaPP and cleaning validation:

blocks.zh: 取得化合物 ADE（毒理學評估）
blocks.en: Obtain the compound's ADE (toxicological assessment)

blocks.zh: 根據批量大小、設備接觸面積、後續產品最小劑量計算清潔限值（swab 或 rinse 限值）
blocks.en: Calculate the cleaning limit (swab or rinse limit) from the batch size, equipment contact surface area and the minimum dose of the next product

blocks.zh: 確認分析方法靈敏度足以偵測該限值
blocks.en: Confirm that the sensitivity of the analytical method is sufficient to detect that limit

blocks.zh: 驗證清潔程序可將殘留量降至限值以下
blocks.en: Verify that the cleaning procedure can reduce residues below the limit

blocks.zh: 持續監控（生命週期方法）
blocks.en: Monitor continuously (lifecycle approach)

blocks.zh: 2.5.4 Regulatory Environment（法規環境演進）
blocks.en: 2.5.4 Regulatory Environment

blocks.zh: 「不得人為降低 ADE」的重要警示
blocks.en: The Important Warning against "Artificially Lowering the ADE"

blocks.zh: 第 6 點（健康暴露限值不應人為降低）是業界常見錯誤的直接反應：
blocks.en: Point 6 (health-based exposure limits should not be artificially lowered) is a direct response to a common industry mistake:

blocks.zh: 錯誤做法：毒理學家算出 ADE = 1 mg/day，管理層說「太高了，改成 0.1 mg/day 更安全」。
blocks.en: Wrong approach: the toxicologist calculates ADE = 1 mg/day, and management says, "That's too high; change it to 0.1 mg/day to be safer."

blocks.zh: 問題：如果 0.1 mg/day 是正確的科學限值，那原本的毒理學評估有誤；如果 1 mg/day 是科學正確的，人為降低到 0.1 mg/day 的唯一效果是讓不必要的「不符合規定」更容易發生，然後需要解釋「為什麼超出一個不必要嚴格的限值是可接受的」——這在邏輯上是自相矛盾的。
blocks.en: Problem: if 0.1 mg/day is the correct scientific limit, the original toxicological assessment was wrong; if 1 mg/day is scientifically correct, the only effect of lowering it artificially to 0.1 mg/day is to make unnecessary "non-compliances" more likely, which then have to be explained as "why exceeding an unnecessarily strict limit is acceptable", and this is logically self-contradictory.

blocks.zh: 「避免情緒化標籤」的文化意義
blocks.en: The Cultural Significance of "Avoiding Emotional Labels"

blocks.zh: 第 3 點批評「cytotoxic」「potent」等主觀標籤——這是對舊文化的挑戰。在製藥業，「這是細胞毒性藥物，必須最高等級防護」是一種自動觸發的決策模式，不需要科學計算。Risk-MaPP 說：不對。你需要算 ADE、評估暴露、才能決定管控等級。這個轉變需要組織文化的改變。
blocks.en: Point 3 criticizes subjective labels such as "cytotoxic" and "potent", which challenges the old culture. In the pharmaceutical industry, "this is a cytotoxic drug, so it must have the highest level of protection" is an automatic decision pattern that requires no scientific calculation. Risk-MaPP says: no. You need to calculate the ADE and assess exposure before deciding the level of control. This shift requires a change in organizational culture.

blocks.zh: 2.6 Overview of the Risk Management Approach（風險管理方法概覽）
blocks.en: 2.6 Overview of the Risk Management Approach

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 風險管理流程詳解
blocks.en: The ICH Q9 Risk Management Process Explained

blocks.zh: Figure 2.1🔍 雖然是圖表，但核心邏輯是：
blocks.en: Figure 2.1🔍 is a diagram, but the core logic is:

blocks.zh: ① 危害識別
blocks.en: ① Hazard identification

blocks.zh: ② 風險分析
blocks.en: ② Risk analysis

blocks.zh: ③ 風險評估
blocks.en: ③ Risk evaluation

blocks.zh: ④ 風險可接受？
blocks.en: ④ Is the risk acceptable?

blocks.zh: 若不可接受 ↓           若可接受 ↓
blocks.en: If not acceptable ↓           If acceptable ↓

blocks.zh: ⑤ 風險降低
blocks.en: ⑤ Risk reduction

blocks.zh: →（循環回③）
blocks.en: → (loop back to ③)

blocks.zh: ⑥ 風險接受
blocks.en: ⑥ Risk acceptance

blocks.zh: ⑦ 風險審查
blocks.en: ⑦ Risk review

blocks.zh: ⑧ 風險溝通（貫穿全程）
blocks.en: ⑧ Risk communication (throughout)

blocks.zh: 「努力程度與風險成比例」原則
blocks.en: The Principle That "Effort Is Proportionate to Risk"

blocks.zh: 這個原則很實用：
blocks.en: This principle is very practical:

blocks.zh: 低 ADE 化合物（高危害）→ 需要詳盡的定量風險評估
blocks.en: Low-ADE compounds (high hazard) → need a thorough quantitative risk assessment

blocks.zh: 高 ADE 化合物（低危害）→ 定性或半定量評估可能已足夠
blocks.en: High-ADE compounds (low hazard) → a qualitative or semi-quantitative assessment may be sufficient

blocks.zh: 已有大量歷史數據的熟悉化合物 → 可引用既有評估
blocks.en: Familiar compounds with a large body of historical data → can refer to existing assessments

blocks.zh: 全新、數據稀少的化合物 → 需要更保守的評估方法
blocks.en: New compounds with sparse data → need a more conservative assessment approach

blocks.zh: 不是每個化合物都需要完整的 500 頁風險評估報告——但這個判斷本身需要專業判斷。
blocks.en: Not every compound needs a complete 500-page risk assessment report, but making that judgment itself takes professional judgment.

blocks.zh: 2.7 Use of Health-Based Exposure Limits（健康暴露限值的應用）
blocks.en: 2.7 Use of Health-Based Exposure Limits

blocks.zh: 致癌物的特殊處理：線性無閾值模型
blocks.en: Special Handling of Carcinogens: The Linear No-Threshold Model

blocks.zh: 一般毒性化合物使用「閾值模型」（NOAEL → 安全係數 → ADE）；但對基因毒性/致突變物質（mutagens），使用不同的「線性無閾值模型」：
blocks.en: General toxic compounds use a "threshold model" (NOAEL → safety factors → ADE); for genotoxic/mutagenic substances (mutagens), however, a different "linear no-threshold model" is used:

blocks.zh: ICH M7 設定 1/100,000（十萬分之一）終生超額癌症風險
blocks.en: ICH M7 sets a lifetime excess cancer risk of 1/100,000 (one in a hundred thousand)

blocks.zh: TTC（毒理學關注閾值）= 1.5 μg/day（當數據不足時的保守預設值）
blocks.en: TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern) = 1.5 µg/day (a conservative default when data are insufficient)

blocks.zh: 這個數字比一般 ADE 通常要嚴格得多
blocks.en: This figure is generally much stricter than a typical ADE

blocks.zh: 比喻：速限的制定原理
blocks.en: Analogy: How Speed Limits Are Set

blocks.zh: ADE 就像道路速限——不是「越慢越安全」就越好。速限是根據道路設計、事故統計、使用者特性等數據科學制定的「平衡點」。人為將 ADE 降低十倍，就像把安全速限 60 km/h 改為 6 km/h——雖然更「保守」，但不必要的嚴格且不符合科學。
blocks.en: The ADE is like a road speed limit: slower is not always better. A speed limit is a "balance point" set scientifically from data such as road design, accident statistics and user characteristics. Artificially lowering the ADE tenfold is like changing a safe speed limit of 60 km/h to 6 km/h: although more "conservative", it is unnecessarily strict and not scientifically justified.

blocks.zh: HBEL vs. OEL：關鍵區別
blocks.en: HBEL vs. OEL: Key Differences

blocks.zh: 這是 Risk-MaPP 最重要的概念區分之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important conceptual distinctions in Risk-MaPP:

blocks.zh: 2.8 The GMP and Industrial Hygiene Balance（GMP 與工業衛生的平衡）
blocks.en: 2.8 The GMP and Industrial Hygiene Balance

blocks.zh: GMP 視角 vs. 工業衛生視角：為何兩者都重要
blocks.en: GMP Perspective vs. Industrial Hygiene Perspective: Why Both Matter

blocks.zh: 這兩個視角在製藥廠中代表兩個不同的職能部門：
blocks.en: In a pharmaceutical plant these two perspectives represent two different functional departments:

blocks.zh: GMP/品質部門：關注病患安全，產品殘留，清潔驗證
blocks.en: GMP/Quality department: focuses on patient safety, product residues, cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 工業衛生/HSE 部門：關注員工安全，工作環境暴露，PPE
blocks.en: Industrial hygiene/HSE department: focuses on employee safety, workplace exposure, PPE

blocks.zh: 問題：這兩個部門使用不同的標準體系，有時會產生矛盾。例如：某藥品 OEL = 0.01 mg/m³（工業衛生認為極危險）但 ADE = 5 mg/day（GMP 認為殘留風險很低）。如何整合？
blocks.en: Problem: the two use different systems of standards, which can sometimes conflict. For example, a drug has an OEL = 0.01 mg/m³ (industrial hygiene considers it extremely hazardous) but an ADE = 5 mg/day (GMP considers the residue risk very low). How do you reconcile them?

blocks.zh: OEL vs. ADE 的數值關係
blocks.en: The Numerical Relationship between OEL and ADE

blocks.zh: 兩者可以相互換算但不能直接比較：
blocks.en: The two can be converted into each other but cannot be compared directly:

blocks.zh: OEL（mg/m³）需要乘以呼吸量（約 10 m³/8小時工作日）才能得到每日攝入量
blocks.en: The OEL (mg/m³) must be multiplied by the breathing volume (about 10 m³ per 8-hour working day) to obtain the daily intake

blocks.zh: ADE（mg/day）是更通用的基礎，可以轉換成任何暴露場景的限值
blocks.en: The ADE (mg/day) is the more general basis and can be converted into a limit for any exposure scenario

blocks.zh: 通常：ADE < OEL 轉換後的日劑量（因為病患保護需要更嚴格）
blocks.en: Normally: ADE < the daily dose converted from the OEL (because patient protection requires a stricter limit)

blocks.zh: 但也有例外：某些藥物對工人的吸入途徑特別危險（職業性哮喘），OEL 可能更嚴格
blocks.en: There are exceptions, however: for some drugs the inhalation route is particularly dangerous for workers (occupational asthma), and the OEL may be stricter

blocks.zh: 比喻：工廠消防安全 vs. 生產安全的協調
blocks.en: Analogy: Coordinating Fire Safety and Production Safety in a Factory

blocks.zh: 消防部門說：「這個化學品儲存量超過消防規定，必須減少」；生產部門說：「我們需要這個量才能保持生產連續性」。兩者都對，但需要一個整合方案。Risk-MaPP 的 IH-GMP 平衡就是同樣的整合思維——不能只顧一方而忽略另一方。
blocks.en: The fire department says, "The storage quantity of this chemical exceeds fire regulations and must be reduced"; production says, "We need this quantity to keep production continuous." Both are right, but an integrated solution is needed. The IH-GMP balance in Risk-MaPP applies the same integrative thinking: you cannot look after one side and ignore the other.

blocks.zh: CDMO 組織架構啟示
blocks.en: Implications for CDMO Organization Structure

blocks.zh: 這個章節對 CDMO 組織架構有直接啟示：
blocks.en: This section has direct implications for the organization of a CDMO:

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 風險評估團隊應同時包含 GMP/品質代表和工業衛生/HSE 代表
blocks.en: The Risk-MaPP risk assessment team should include both GMP/quality and industrial hygiene/HSE representatives

blocks.zh: 新產品引入評估流程應同時觸發 GMP 風險評估（交叉污染）和 IH 暴露評估（員工安全）
blocks.en: The new product introduction assessment process should trigger both a GMP risk assessment (cross-contamination) and an IH exposure assessment (employee safety)

blocks.zh: 兩者都認為「可接受」才能啟動生產，不能只過一方的審核
blocks.en: Production can start only when both consider the risk "acceptable"; clearing only one review is not enough

blocks.zh: 如果兩者結論衝突（例如 GMP 說 OK 但 IH 說需要更高防護），需要有明確的決策程序
blocks.en: If the two conclusions conflict (for example, GMP says OK but IH says higher protection is needed), a clear decision procedure is needed

blocks.zh: 本節重點摘要 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Risk-MaPP 使命：為共用廠房的交叉污染風險管理提供科學的、基於 ICH Q9 的系統化方法，同時保護病患（GMP）和員工（IH）
blocks.en: Risk-MaPP mission: provide a scientific, ICH Q9-based systematic approach to managing cross-contamination risk in shared facilities, protecting both patients (GMP) and employees (IH)

blocks.zh: 零風險哲學突破：ICH、FDA、EMA 三大機構一致認可「零風險不可及亦不必要」，以「可接受風險」替代「零容忍」作為決策標準
blocks.en: The zero-risk philosophical breakthrough: ICH, FDA and EMA agree that "zero risk is neither attainable nor necessary", and use "acceptable risk" in place of "zero tolerance" as the decision criterion

blocks.zh: 五大修訂驅動：EU GMP Ch.3/5 更新、EMA HBEL 指引（2014）、ICH M7、生命週期驗證方法、業界經驗積累
blocks.en: Five revision drivers: EU GMP Ch.3/5 update, EMA HBEL guideline (2014), ICH M7, lifecycle approach to validation, accumulated industry experience

blocks.zh: 關鍵等號 PDE ≡ ADE：EMA 明確聲明兩者「本質上同義」，統一了 EU（PDE）與業界（ADE）的術語
blocks.en: The key equation PDE ≡ ADE: EMA explicitly states the two are "essentially synonymous", unifying the EU (PDE) and industry (ADE) terminology

blocks.zh: 必須專用廠房的三個條件（EU GMP 3.6）：管制措施不足、毒理學不支持可控風險（如 Beta-Lactam 致敏性）、無法驗證的分析方法
blocks.en: Three conditions requiring dedicated facilities (EU GMP 3.6): controls are insufficient, toxicology does not support controllable risk (such as beta-lactam sensitization), analytical methods cannot be validated

blocks.zh: HBEL vs. OEL 核心差異：HBEL（ADE/PDE）保護病患，以 mg/day 表達；OEL 保護工人，以 mg/m³ 表達——兩套標準需分別評估且同時滿足
blocks.en: Core difference between HBEL and OEL: the HBEL (ADE/PDE) protects patients and is expressed in mg/day; the OEL protects workers and is expressed in mg/m³. The two sets of standards must be assessed separately and both satisfied

blocks.zh: 風險管理生命週期：識別 → 分析 → 評估 → 控制 → 降低 → 接受 → 審查 → 溝通（貫穿全程）——對應 Risk-MaPP 第 5-13 章
blocks.en: Risk management lifecycle: Identification → Analysis → Evaluation → Control → Reduction → Acceptance → Review → Communication (throughout), corresponding to Chapters 5-13 of Risk-MaPP

blocks.zh: Annex 15 清潔驗證革命：2015 年更新要求清潔限值必須基於毒理學評估（ADE/PDE），取代舊有的 10 ppm 或 1/1000 TDD 經驗法則；PIC/S 同步跟進
blocks.en: The Annex 15 cleaning validation revolution: the 2015 update requires cleaning limits to be based on a toxicological assessment (ADE/PDE), replacing the old 10 ppm or 1/1000 TDD rules of thumb; PIC/S followed at the same time
